Software Advice

Tools that move at your pace

From first tap to repeat visit, SumUp offers a full suite of POS products and tools. Pick the setup that feels right today, then easily add more as your business hits its next milestone.

Connect with your customers

SumUp Connect turns first-timers into regulars with an all-in-one customer loyalty platform. Reach the right customers at the right time with always-on AutoPilot SMS messaging. Build the perfect promo with AI-enhanced messaging and much more.

Checkouts and connections in one place

From making sales to rewarding customers, all the moving parts of your business are built into one easy system.

Small-business friendly pricing

Whether you need a card reader with a low-cost plan or a feature-packed POS system to help your business grow, we’ve got you covered. Our plan and pricing options are built to support every stage of your small business.

Join a community of millions

From the shop next door to cafés across the globe, over 4 million merchants trust us to move billions of dollars every month.

A safe pair of hands

You’re trusting us with your money and we take that seriously. Fully regulated, fully compliant, fully safe.

Help when you need it

With people-first support and a community cheering you on, you’re never on your own.

Other tools at your fingertips

Start for free with the SumUp Business app. Get paid, track your sales, manage your money, and more. All from your phone, and all without the fuss.

When the neighborhood wakes up

As lights switch on and “open” signs flip over, SumUp POS is ready for every checkout. We help small businesses turn Saturday traffic into steady momentum.
